# India's Next Dancer 2027

> India's Next Dancer 2027 is a nationwide freestyle dance competition presented by KGIL Productions. Auditions run in 10 major Indian cities across four categories — Kids (5–12, solo), Teens (13–19, solo), Adults (20+, solo) and Group (2–10 members) — with a total prize pool of ₹28,00,000 and a live National Grand Finale in Mumbai in July 2027.

Key facts:
- Organiser: KGIL Productions, registered in Pune, Maharashtra, India
- Format: freestyle — any dance form is welcome (classical, folk, street, contemporary, Bollywood, fusion)
- Rounds: 1) City auditions in 10 cities, 2)  National  National Semifinals, 3) National Grand Finale in Mumbai with celebrity judges
- Prizes per category: 1st place ₹5,00,000; 2nd place ₹2,00,000 (8 winners across 4 categories)
- Status: registrations open soon; audition cities and dates will be announced when registration opens
